weaknesses.title: SYS APPEND works but invisible in forms/search/HELP catalog
weaknesses.detail: SYS APPEND|LOG is implemented (history logs without READ+CAT+WRITE) and used successfully for INVENTORY_LOG.txt, but forms APPEND and search APPEND return n=0. Agents discover JOINLINES/JOIN but not APPEND — forces shell or rewrite loops.
weaknesses.repro: ./out/cubalc forms APPEND; ./out/cubalc search APPEND → empty. Program APPEND log still writes.

weaknesses.title: JOINLINES silent trunc at CUBALC_HOST_STR_MAX (8192)
weaknesses.detail: JOINLINES copies into fixed out[8192]; long inventories truncate without OK=0 or truncated flag. JOIN_N still counts all fields even if paste body cut off — agents can mis-size reports.
weaknesses.repro: Large LIST → JOINLINES ','; compare strlen(LAST) vs sum of field lengths + seps.

weaknesses.title: Still no numeric→string for report CAT chains
weaknesses.detail: Building INVENTORY body needs counts (batch_n) in text plate but CAT only joins strings; program leaves n= to PRINT_JSON machine plate. Agents still need dual report paths (human CAT plate vs PRINT_JSON).
weaknesses.repro: SYS CAT body batch_n does not stringify number cleanly for plate text.

weaknesses.title: Peer soft dial still requires host CUBALC_P2P_SOFT=1
weaknesses.detail: Language cannot set host soft-dial policy; program must detect ENV and skip or risk hard fail. Documented skip path when peers set without SOFT.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_INV_PEERS set without CUBALC_P2P_SOFT=1 → program notes soft_required / skip.

weaknesses.title: INCLUDE OR sticky last_err needs CLEAR_ERR for -s (known, still real)
weaknesses.detail: Soft plugin miss recovered via PASS+CLEAR_ERR; without CLEAR_ERR, -s fails after intentional optional miss.
weaknesses.repro: INCLUDE OR missing; omit CLEAR_ERR; run -q -s → ok=false

workarounds: Know SYS APPEND from source/error strings; not forms catalog
TAKE before JOINLINES to bound CSV size under 8KiB
PRINT_JSON for numeric inventory metrics; CAT for name CSV only
Always set CUBALC_P2P_SOFT=1 and short TIMEOUT for peer inventory probes
CLEAR_ERR after every intentional soft FAIL/INCLUDE OR under -s
language_gaps: Catalog SYS APPEND|LOG in forms/search/HELP (parity with JOINLINES)
JOINLINES truncated flag or OK=0 on overflow
itoa / SYS STR num for plate text without PRINT_JSON dual path
In-language soft-dial default when peer list present
Recursive LIST for nested asset trees
